development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

hypothesis: Transfer comparable relative trend, volatility and activity state from other real inverse/leveraged ETF pairs. Auxiliary instruments are training-only. Trade SOXL/SOXS/CASH only. Compare partial sharing, no sharing, and complete sharing on exactly the same dates/features.
features: 18 fields registered in FIELDS and feature_row. Daily returns use 21 previous official complete split-economic regular closes available before day00ET. Sample sigma20 floor1e-4; trend1/sigma, trend5/(sigma sqrt5), trend20/(sigma sqrt20), log sigma20, sigma5/sigma20, benchmark minus SPY 5day return/(sigma sqrt5), current completed benchmark quote/prior close scaled sigma, current quote/15minutes-earlier quote scaled sigma, SPY current scaled SPY sigma, SPY trend5 scaled,20-change directional efficiency, mean long/short activity, half long-minus-short activity, half benchmark-minus-SPY activity, direction/current interaction, relative/current interaction, trend5/current interaction, summed pair current return/(sigmaLong+sigmaShort). z-scores and interactions clipped[-8,8], volatility ratio capped8. No target-month or identity one-hot features.
activity: Raw typical-price times raw volume summed over complete04:00ET-to-clock 5m prefix; activity=clip(log(current/meanprevious20sameclock official eligible dates),-3,3). All prior20 required; no skip missing. Exact quote atdecision-30s and quote15min earlier. Historical bar available=end+1s assumption, not actual receipt. Volume describes activity, not signed net fund flow.
labels: Own real ETF fixed6%stop/+5%TP/14inclusive-calendar contract, original costs/splits/dividends. C=(log1p(netLong)+log1p(netShort))/2,D=half difference. Entire14day official window must be complete before training/calibration; release=max last window bar available for both sides, no early-positive labels. Historical corporate action metadata retrospectively verified, historical announcement receipt unproven.
training: Every ETday00:00 rebuild each clock from expanding complete whole-date chronological prefix matched across all3pairs/all eligible clocks. Stop at first unmatured date, never skip unknown labels. At least120 real dates perclock. Date weights half-life126, normalized sum N then divided equally by3pairs; duplicated rows do not increase real N. Own pair weighted centers/scales/intercepts. Query current state never enters training. Base model output C±D is expected log net return, not success probability.
pooling: Frozen v70 augmented least-squares implementation. Loss +100||weighted mean slope||^2+300sum(pair mass||pair slope-mean||^2). Independent penalty100sum(pair mass||pair slope||^2) and must match semiconductor-only ridge on matched dates. Pooled has one standardized slope and own intercepts, penalty100. Exact same samples/features/costs and own calibration pervariant.
calibration: Reuse v55 normalized8clock residual model: each own as-issued semiconductor predictions; latest120/min60 whole mature dates;63datehalf-life;199joint10date bootstraps. Fixed20mean+80/kdeviation penalty. Primary selects greatest calibrated lower bound>1e-12, tieSOXL elseCASH. Common radius=max(0,90th percentile max(draw-point)); uncertainty conditional on fixed basefit, not full model/monthly guarantee.
decision: PRIMARY partial_band. Point variants diagnostics only; premarket-only uses primary at09:25:30; double_cost uses same primary decisions and2xactual costs. All allocation0/1. Missing input, insufficient fit/calibration or expired unresolved prefix =>CASH. No diagnostic route can rescue primary failure.
case_rule: No new May-Sep model/capital evaluation unless independently verified PRIMARY development passes. Data extension and exact development-prefix check required before cases. Existing history remains exposed development regression.
verification: All causal feature definitions independently recomputed; raw auxiliary contract replay; all base normal equations and no-sharing solo equivalence; daily training availability, immutable predictions, full own residual calibration and9capital/statistic books. Results cannot claim independent strategy validation.
